capabilities: Display a floating formatting toolbar under the editor
Add or remove commands from the menu in settings
Add underline, superscript, and subscript commands
Restyle the menu with a glassmorphism look
Adjust the menu position, hide it, and change its columns
extras: The README includes a development checklist with unfinished items (text selection detection, nested menus, cursor-following) and notes a known workaround for a Sliding Panes conflict.
motivation: The author wanted a simple text editor modal so note-takers can mark up their notes without memorizing hotkeys.
problem: Obsidian requires memorizing hotkeys or multiple key presses to apply text markup, which slows down note-takers who just want to write.

relations.evidence: The plugins Templater and Hotkeys for Templates are strongly recommended to use with cMenu.
The plugins Templater and Hotkeys for Templates are strongly recommended to use with cMenu.
For those that use the plugin Sliding Panes, you can now change cMenu's append method to "body."

summary: Floating formatting toolbar that shows customizable command buttons (bold, italics, underline, etc.) below the editor for writing without hotkeys.
